Evidence per pair is in docs/seo/CANNIBALIZATION_AND_MIGRATION_MAP_2026-08-01.md.

clusters.note: sayt yaratish xizmati was added to the hub on 2026-08-21. Live SERP evidence of that day: the bare head term returns a mixed do-it-yourself result set (a free site builder at 1, a YouTube tutorial at 2, SITE123 and site.pro in the top ten, Wikipedia at 18), while sayt yaratish xizmati returns twelve commercial studio pages and nothing else. Rather than split the hub, the commercial variant is claimed by the same URL so the page can carry both the head term it already ranks for and the phrase that actually converts. Google Ads data for location 2860 on the same day: sayt yaratish 1300/mo competition 0.15, sayt yaratish xizmati 260/mo competition 0.12, veb sayt yaratish 210/mo, sayt yaratish narxi 50/mo. Keyword difficulty is unavailable for this market. Toshkentda sayt buyurtma qilish returned no volume and is deliberately not claimed by any URL. The four spokes added on 2026-08-01 in the authority sprint are buyer-journey resources, not volume bets: the paid research of the same day returned no measurable volume for their topics, and none of them may ever claim a hub keyword. They exist to answer distinct pre-purchase questions and to route internal authority to the hub. Rejected in the same pass: a development-process article (the hub's own «Ish jarayoni» section owns it), a launch checklist (absorbed into the preparation article), and a standalone technical-brief article (absorbed into the preparation article).
